Access Control

Review allows viewing, printing and exporting. Write also allows adding and editing, but not deleting or replacing existing records. The shared level applies to the three embedded MPL tools; FINSYS access is managed separately. This is a workflow-level control in a static file, not server-enforced security. The master account (MPL) always has Write access and cannot be edited here.
